body:
That Dagger One



REMEMBER THAT THIS MOD IS WAYYYY BETTER IF YOU PLAY IT WITH FRIENDS!!!!!!!!!



This mod adds a single new item that has a whole bunch of easter eggs, not only that, but it adds a painting that contains a deep meaning..



That One Dagger is large (intentionaly) due to the features it has been given.. It is a forbidden weapon with alot of lore YOU, the player, needs to find out.



It is dropped by the That Dagger One Protecter which is a mob extremely powerful.



SPOILER ALERT! HERE ARE ALL THE FEATURES / EASTER EGGS IN THAT ONE DAGGER.



1. It uses your xp as ammo to shoot small fireball

2. It will levitate anything you hit with it for a certain amount of time

3. If you hit a sheep with it though, then expect a naughty suprise ;)

4. It works as a pickaxe

5. Its durabilty is 1227

6. It can break even bedrock but not obsidian though
